description: This file defines the TaxClass entity class used in the sales management system. It models a tax class with properties like code, title, associated products, merchant store, and tax rates, including relevant ORM mappings and annotations.

classes.name: TaxClass
classes.description: Represents a tax classification with code, title, associated products, merchant store, and tax rates. It is mapped to the TAX_CLASS database table with ORM annotations for persistence.

methods.name: TaxClass
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a TaxClass with a given code and sets the title to the same value.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the tax class.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the tax class.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the title of the tax class.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the tax class.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code of the tax class.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code of the tax class.

methods.name: getTaxRates
methods.description: Returns the list of tax rates associated with this tax class.

methods.name: setTaxRates
methods.description: Sets the list of tax rates associated with this tax class.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Retrieves the merchant store associated with this tax class.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this tax class.
